indiapost.gov.in India Post GDS 3rd Merit List 2026 Out

TheIndia Post GDS 3rd merit List 2026 was finally released on 11th May 2026. Earlier the department released the 2nd Merit List on 10th April 2026. The 1st Merit List wass released on 6th March 2026. The recruitment is being conducted for 28,636 GDS Posts including BPM and ABPM vacancies. Candidates are selected based on their 10th class marks and no written exam is conducted. Candidates can now check state wise GDS 3rd merit list PDF online.

Who conducts the GDS Recruitment 2026?

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 is conducted by the Department of Posts, which operates under the Ministry of Communications of the Government of India. The recruitment process is managed across various postal circles nationwide to fill vacancies for Branch Postmasters (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmasters (ABPM), and Dak Sevaks.

How to Check Indian Post GDS 3rd Merit List 2026?

Candidates can check India Post GDS 3rd merit list 2026 online through the official portal. The merit list has been released in PDF Format for all postal circles. Candidates can follow the steps below to check 3rd merit list.

  1. Visit the official website @indiapost.gov.in.
  2. Click on 3rd Merit List.
  3. Select Postal Circle/State.
  4. Download the merit list PDF.
  5. Open the PDF and search registration number.
  6. If the registration number appears in the list then you are shortlisted for the next stage i.e., document verification and medical examination.

What Next After India Post GDS 3rd Merit List 2026?

After the India Post GDS 3rd Merit list 2026, shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. Candidates must carry all requisite original documents. After DV medical examination will be conducted. Final selection will be confirmed only after both stages are successfully completed.
